package.name: unitree_bridge
package.description: Bridges geometry_msgs/Twist cmd_vel to Unitree Go2 high-level sport-mode velocity control (unitree_sdk2 go2::SportClient::Move), with a safety watchdog that stops the robot when cmd_vel stops arriving. unitree_sdk2 itself is a plain CMake package installed at /opt/unitree_robotics, not a catkin/rosdep package, so it is not listed as a dependency here; see CMakeLists.txt.
